Ans = "No"
piano = "wbwbwwbwbwbw"
n = len(piano)

# Use a sliding window approach to check for the required number of 'w' and 'b'
for start in range(n):
    w_count = 0
    b_count = 0
    for length in range(W + B):
        if piano[(start + length) % n] == 'w':
            w_count += 1
        elif piano[(start + length) % n] == 'b':
            b_count += 1
        if w_count == W and b_count == B:
            Ans = "Yes"

    if Ans == "Yes":
